task.title: How to Assign Events
task.shortdesc: In order to make someone the event supervisor, you have to assign the event to them. Here's how to do that!

context.p: Every event should have an event supervisor: someone who will proctor and grade the event. Some events may have more than one, but each event supervisor should have access to their event. Here's how to assign it.

step.cmd: In the "Members" tab, find the person you want to assign a specific event to.

In their row, click the edit button. (See below) Screenshot of the Tournament Director's view of the member's tab, showing three participants: two already registered with the tournament, one with the invite pending. The edit button has been boxed in red.
In the list of events that pops up, select whichever event(s) you want to assign to the person.
